name: Sei Chakuero Gakuen ~Nugikake Bukkake Ojou-sama!~
original_name: 聖・ちゃくエロ学園 ～脱ぎかけぶっかけお嬢様！～
source:
Takumi is a transfer student to a very prestigious formerly all girl's school. He is now the only boy in a school filled with beautiful wealthy girls. However his dream of his own personal harem is shattered when the girls would all rather make friends with each other than with him, he finds himself alone every day unable to make even a single friend. After a month he finally gives up and decides to leave the school.

"Garden" is a club created by six elite girls including the class president of the school. Every day they meet to enjoy chatting over lunch and afternoon tea under the pretense of improving relations between boys and girls, however if Takumi quits school it will be an all girl's school again and their club will be disbanded. Hoping to preserve their club they extend an invitation for Takumi to join and what better way to improve relations between boys and girls than through sex?
translation:
拓海是一所非常有声望的前女子学校的转学生。他现在是一所充满美丽富家女的学校里唯一的男孩。然而，当女孩们都宁愿彼此交朋友而不是与他交朋友时，他的私人后宫梦想破灭了，他发现自己每天都孤身一人，连一个朋友都交不到。一个月后，他终于放弃并决定离开学校。

“花园”是由包括学校班长在内的六名精英女孩创建的社团。他们每天都会聚在一起吃午餐和下午茶，以改善男女关系为借口聊天，但如果拓海退学，学校将再次成为女子学校，他们的俱乐部将被解散。为了保留他们的俱乐部，他们邀请拓海加入，还有什么比通过性来改善男孩和女孩之间的关系更好的方法呢？
